open_points.subject: check_value_forms
open_points.text: check_value_forms: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer one RefusalFailure, carrying the value's path, for every form value outside its form and none for the others, in the order of form_values, each value's form chosen by its field of = models.FormField and each failure's kind the member of = models.RefusalKind, the OUTSIDE_FORM member or the OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member, whose value the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant maps the value of that field to: a value of the ALIAS member of = models.FormField longer than the imported ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS constant counted in Unicode code points, one of the FLOOR_AREA member of = models.FormField for which _read_decimal_text answers None or whose Decimal is not greater than the imported OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE constant, one of the ROOMS_COUNT member of = models.FormField for which _read_whole_number_text answers None or whose integer is less than the imported OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN constant, one of the FLOOR member of = models.FormField for which _read_whole_number_text answers None, one of the OBJECT_KIND member of = models.FormField outside = models.ObjectKind, one of the CUSTOMER_LANGUAGE member of = models.FormField outside = models.CustomerLanguage or one of the CUSTOMER_KIND member of = models.FormField outside = models.CustomerKind.
open_points.rule: подмножество членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list. Код читает их как константу поставщика данных (§15.3.1, §6.10), а не как прозу рядом с `= models.X`.
open_points.question: Remove the inline OUTSIDE_FORM/OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST subset and require the failure kind solely through the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant.

open_points.subject: check_value_forms
open_points.text: check_value_forms: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show, at each bound and one step past it, that an alias of exactly the imported ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS constant in Unicode code points passes and one code point more is refused, characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane counted as one; a number of rooms equal to the imported OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN constant passes while one below it and one with a fraction are each refused; a floor area equal to the imported OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE constant or below it is refused and a floor area above it passes, its Decimal kept exactly as written; a negative whole floor passes and a floor with a fraction is refused; an object kind outside = models.ObjectKind, a customer language outside = models.CustomerLanguage and a customer kind outside = models.CustomerKind are refused; each refusal's kind is the member of = models.RefusalKind, the OUTSIDE_FORM member or the OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member, whose value the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant maps the value of its field to; several values outside their form are all answered together, each with its path.
open_points.rule: подмножество членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list. Код читает их как константу поставщика данных (§15.3.1, §6.10), а не как прозу рядом с `= models.X`.
open_points.question: Remove the inline OUTSIDE_FORM/OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST subset and state that the test expects the member selected through the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant.
